title: Quantities and processing totals
brief: Reconcile quantities and processing totals at their actual grains.
instructions: Return all orders. Independently sum ordered item quantities, refunded return quantities and amounts, and succeeded payments. Fill missing totals with zero. Processing snapshots are not an accounting balance.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,status from orders without solving quantities and processing totals.

hints.text: Aggregate each detail source at its own grain before joining.
Join returns to items only to recover the order identity; separately summarize items and payments.
Order 1 has two returns for one item and several payment snapshots.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items i USING(order_item_id) WHERE i.order_id = 1)::VARCHAR || '/' || (SELECT count(DISTINCT r.order_item_id) FROM returns r JOIN order_items i USING(order_item_id) WHERE i.order_id = 1)::VARCHAR || '/' || (SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE order_id = 1)::VARCHAR
